name: A Ninja's Return
source:
You awaken after the toughest battle of your life.

The village you saved is rebuilding, and for the first time in a long while, you are forced to slow down. While recovering in a quiet corner of the village, familiar faces begin to appear. Some come to help. Some come out of curiosity. Others come for reasons you may not fully understand.

What begins as a simple recovery quickly turns into something more.

As the days pass, you spend time with those around you, rebuilding old connections and forming new ones. Who you choose to spend time with will shape how these relationships develop, leading to rare and exciting moments and events.
